title: Existing installations.
officialText:
Except as otherwise provided for in this chapter or elsewhere in this code, a provision in this code shall
not require the removal, alteration or abandonment of, nor prevent the continued utilization and maintenance of, a mechanical
system lawfully in existence on the effective date of this code.
